item.title: Despite Ava Christopher’s heroics, Norwin falls to Altoona in OT in PIAA 6A 1st round
item.description: ALTOONA — With four seconds left in regulation and her team down three, Norwin’s Ava Christopher banked in a 3-pointer to take the game to overtime against Altoona in the first round of the PIAA Class 6A tournament Friday night.

item.title: Minor league report: Penguins lose 3rd consecutive game
item.description: Goaltender Sergei Murashov made 20 saves on 23 shots for the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins in a 3-2 overtime loss to the Syracuse Crunch at the Oncenter War Memorial in Syracuse, N.Y., on Friday.

item.title: Honor Huff scores 24 to lead West Virginia win in regular-season finale
item.description: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. — Honor Huff scored 24 points, and West Virginia finished off a season sweep of UCF with a 77-62 victory Friday night to close out the Big 12 regular season.

item.title: Daniel Berger handles the ‘US Open in spring’ by building 5-shot lead at Bay Hill
item.description: ORLANDO, Fla. — Daniel Berger loves playing in Florida in March. For most everyone else Friday in the Arnold Palmer Invitational, Bay Hill made it feel like a spring preview of the U.S. Open.

item.title: High school roundup for March 6, 2026: WPIAL champ Shady Side Academy girls pull out 1st-round win in OT
item.description: Karis Thomas scored 22 points, including seven in overtime, to lead WPIAL champion Shady Side Academy to a 63-54 win over Marion Center (23-5) in the PIAA Class 3A girls basketball first round Friday night.
